title: 第3章 二垒女友第4章 雷嫂好
content_zh:
不得不说金陵是个风水宝地，四周被群山环绕，川流不息的长江从城市中间流过，秦淮河、金川河、青溪、?板桥河等河流在市内纵横交错，水土木等天地灵气颇为浓郁。
不过令人诟病的是，由于金陵的重工业和制造业极为发达，又四面环山，典型的盆地地形，空气无法流通，导致金陵雾霾非常严重，空气环境非常糟糕，简直可以用恶劣来形容。
站在紫金山巅，俯瞰金陵市，整个城市犹如一个大工地般，到处在修建商业大楼和高层住宅区，还有地下轨道交通，路上渣土车尘土飞扬，掀起漫天的黄沙和灰尘，令人无语至极。
来到地球已有五天时间，每晚在环境清幽的紫金山修炼，白天待在宾馆里休息和整理脑海信息，好在这年代的互联网并不发达，市民关注的焦点是流感，雷劈少年江凡并没有引起太大的轰动。
五天的修炼成果挺不错，在霸道的《混沌造化诀》功法加持下，四肢百骸和丹田内差不多汇聚四分之一灵力，预计二十来天功夫，便可突破炼气修为，正式走上修真大道。
当然也有比较糟心的事，前身卖掉苏州的祖宅，低价转让餐厅，偿还银行债务和拖欠员工的工资后，银行卡余额不足四万元，还有半块雕刻凤凰的翡翠吊坠。
要说四万块钱也算不少，金陵普通工人工资不足一千，一年吃喝拉撒下来可能存不到八千块钱，怎么说四万块钱相当于一个工人五年的积蓄。
算了，车到山前必有路，船到桥头自然直，想那破事干什么，走一步看一步，活人还能被尿憋死，何况等江凡突破到炼气期，也能修炼一些修真小技能，赚钱还不是洒洒水。
回到小宾馆简单收拾一番洗漱用品，缓步来到中药大玄武门校区，早上七点，偌大的校园空荡荡，别说什么晨读或晨跑的学生，连吃早餐的学生也没有几个。
少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲！
相比修真界的修士，要么废寝忘食的修炼，要么外出寻找晋级机缘，脑袋时常系在裤腰带上，即使面对未知的无数生命危险，也要舍命争夺机缘，只为问道长生！
四人间的宿舍环境颇为不错，上方是铁床，下方是衣柜和学习书桌，还有一个小阳台，怎么说也是中字头的药学高等学府，要比其他本科院校的六人间、八人间，甚至十人间宿舍好上数倍不止。
一位舍友是金陵本地人，除了刮风下雨等恶劣天气，午间休息偶尔回下宿舍，平时基本不住宿舍；还有一位舍友年初搬离了宿舍，同隔壁东南大学女友在外面租房过上小夫妻生活，之后再也没回过宿舍；而另外一位舍友沉迷于网络游戏，一周七天少说要在网吧玩四天通宵，据说玩游戏《传奇》赚了二十多万。
令人无语吐槽的是，有了血赚二十万的辉煌战绩，整个楼层有一大半学生被老哥带偏，甚至不少学长也被老哥带偏，开始通宵玩游戏《传奇》，幻想着也能够在游戏中发一笔大财。
可以说整个宿舍，前身江凡是唯一长期住客，也有一台去年戴尔顶配台式电脑，却对网络游戏没有丝毫兴趣，平时也就用来查询些学习资料，偶尔逛下天涯、猫扑、泡网等论坛。
江凡好奇打开台式电脑，拨号连接上网，双击企鹅头像，瞬间电脑‘嘀嘀嘀’的响个不停，点开胞妹秦紫菱的头像，话语中充满无尽的自责和愧疚，后悔胆怯怕事，不曾去苏州看望亲生母亲，树欲静而风不止，子欲养而亲不待！
唉，哪有想象中的那么简单，亲生骨肉，江诗雅何曾不想念女儿，每次去燕京在远处偷偷看女儿秦紫菱，母女不能相认，心如刀割，泪水只能往心里咽。
胞妹秦紫菱又何尝不是，从小学习世家教育，明白母亲当年的良苦用心，可秦家嫡系长女的身份又非常尴尬，碍于秦家的颜面，不能前往苏州拜见生母。
好在网络的发展，胞妹秦紫菱在燕京大学自由了些，托在金大读书的燕京好友李子茜联系上江凡，一家三口也才加上企鹅号，在网络社交平台上相识、相知、相爱，也算是在网络上一家三口和睦团圆。
哥哥，你情况怎么样，身体有无大碍，我想去金陵找你，，，看着胞妹那胆颤心惊，生怕失去最后一个亲人的话语，江凡心中流过一阵暖流，内心难免一阵愧疚，地球上的江凡已经不在，但苍玄大陆的江凡在，会把你当做亲妹妹看待，保你一生无忧！

江凡生疏地敲打着键盘，宽慰胞妹不要相信李子茜的鬼话，没有传言的那般恐怖，美利坚的沙利文不是曾被雷电击中七次，每次都平安无事，幸存下来，也没有什么后遗症。
为了给今后逆天开挂找到合适的借口，江凡再次狠狠吹嘘一番，雷击不死的皆是天选之子，经历被雷电击中，智商由原来的120飙升到，身体也打通了任督二脉，拳打牛魔王，脚踢孙悟空，吃嘛嘛香，身体倍儿棒！
真的没事？看着胞妹秦紫菱回复的信息，江凡瞬间一阵尴尬，居然忘记企鹅在年初推出塞班系统的移动聊天企鹅软件，那流量真不是一般人用的起，一张图片的流量相当于一顿午餐。
新身份的适应期，聊天太久容易暴露身份，江凡以要去上课为由，匆匆结束聊天，快速关掉电脑，没办法，最熟悉前身的只剩下胞妹秦紫菱，一句不合时宜的话语可能令对方想入非非。
男生宿舍楼几乎鸦雀无声，可能是前几个月流感肆虐，各大高校施行严格的疫情封控措施，好不容易月初稍微放松封控力度，昨天又是周日，宿舍楼的那帮学生去网吧通宵打游戏了吧。
“雷哥，不，雷爷”
，卧槽，江凡一阵踉跄，刚来到中药学院的教学楼，辅导员老王和不少通宵归来的同学围着江凡唏嘘咋舌，好似看外星人一般，被雷劈居然毫发无伤。
不待江凡开口，一位女生怒气冲冲来到中药学院教学楼前，周边同学看好戏般的快速让出空间，江凡一脸懵逼看向迎面走来的女生，好像有那么一丁点熟悉。
一股压在脑海里的记忆再次涌来，江凡暗暗无语吐槽，前身江凡在生命科学学院还有一位女友，好在关系只是发展到‘二垒’，并未发生什么实质性的关系，不免暗暗庆幸。
“江凡，我们分手吧，与你在一起我担心遭雷劈！”

content_en:
It must be said that Jinling is a geomantic treasure land. It is surrounded by mountains. The ever-flowing Yangtze River flows through the middle of the city. Rivers such as Qinhuai River, Jinchuan River, Qingxi, and Banqiao River crisscross the city. The aura of water, earth, and earth is quite rich.
However, what is criticized is that because Jinling's heavy industry and manufacturing industry are extremely developed, and it is surrounded by mountains and has a typical basin topography, the air cannot circulate. As a result, Jinling's smog is very serious and the air environment is very bad. It can be described as bad.
Standing on the top of Purple Mountain, overlooking Jinling City, the entire city is like a large construction site. Commercial buildings and high-rise residential areas are being built everywhere, as well as underground rail transit. Dust trucks are flying on the road, kicking up yellow sand and dust all over the sky, which makes people speechless.
It has been five days since I came to Earth. I practice every night in the quiet Purple Mountain. I stay in the hotel during the day to rest and organize information in my mind. Fortunately, the Internet in this era is not developed. The focus of public attention is the flu. Jiang Fan, the boy who was struck by lightning, did not cause much of a sensation.
The results of the five days of practice are quite good. With the blessing of the overbearing "Chaos Creation Technique", almost a quarter of the spiritual power has been gathered in the limbs and Dantian. It is expected that in twenty days, he will be able to break through the cultivation of Qi and officially embark on the path of cultivation.
Of course, there are also worse things. My predecessor sold my ancestral home in Suzhou and transferred the restaurant at a low price. After repaying bank debts and arrears of wages to employees, my bank card balance was less than 40,000 yuan, and I still had half a jade pendant with a phoenix carved on it.
Forty thousand yuan is not a lot of money. The average worker in Jinling earns less than one thousand yuan, and he may not be able to save more than eight thousand yuan a year after eating and drinking. After all, forty thousand yuan is equivalent to a worker's five years of savings.
Forget it, there must be a road before the car reaches the mountain, and it will be straight when the boat reaches the bridge. What do you think of doing that nonsense? Just take one step at a time, and a living person can be suffocated to death. What's more, when Jiang Fan breaks through to the Qi refining stage, he can also practice some small cultivation skills, and making money is not just a matter of sprinkling water.
After returning to the small hotel, I simply packed up my toiletries and walked slowly to the Xuanwumen Campus of the University of Traditional Chinese Medicine. At seven in the morning, the huge campus was empty. Not to mention students who were reading or running in the morning, there were only a few students eating breakfast.
If a young man does not work hard, the old man will be miserable!
Compared with the monks in the world of cultivation, they either practice without sleep or food, or go out to look for opportunities to advance. Their heads are often tied to their belts. Even in the face of countless unknown life dangers, they have to risk their lives to fight for opportunities, just to ask for immortality!
The dormitory environment of the four-person dormitory is quite good, with an iron bed above, a wardrobe and study desk below, and a small balcony. It is also a pharmacy institution with a Chinese prefix, and it is many times better than the six-person, eight-person, or even ten-person dormitories in other undergraduate institutions.
One roommate is a native of Jinling. Except for bad weather such as wind and rain, he occasionally returns to the dormitory during lunch breaks and rarely lives in the dormitory. Another roommate moved out of the dormitory at the beginning of the year and rented a house outside with his girlfriend from the Southeast University next door to live as a couple. He never returned to the dormitory again. Another roommate is addicted to online games and plays at least four nights in an Internet cafe seven days a week. It is said that he earned more than 200,000 yuan playing the game "Legend".
What makes people speechless is that with the glorious record of earning 200,000 yuan, more than half of the students on the entire floor were led astray by the old man. Even many seniors were led astray by the old man and started playing the game "Legend" all night long, dreaming that they could make a big fortune in the game.
It can be said that in the whole dormitory, the former Jiang Fan is the only long-term resident. He also has a Dell top-end desktop computer from last year, but he has no interest in online games. He usually uses it to check some study materials and occasionally browses forums such as Tianya, Maopu, and Pao.com.
Jiang Fan curiously opened the desktop computer, dialed up to connect to the Internet, double-clicked the penguin avatar, and instantly the computer beeped non-stop. He clicked on the avatar of his younger sister Qin Ziling, and his words were full of incomprehension.I feel so much self-blame and guilt. I regret that I was too timid to go to Suzhou to visit my biological mother. The tree wants to be quiet but the wind is not stopping. The child wants to be raised but cannot be kissed!
Alas, it is not as simple as imagined. With flesh and blood, Jiang Shiya never misses her daughter. Every time she goes to Yanjing to secretly look at her daughter Qin Ziling from a distance, mother and daughter cannot recognize each other, their hearts are cut like a knife, and tears can only be swallowed in her heart.
Her younger sister Qin Ziling, after all, had studied the education of aristocratic families since she was a child and understood her mother's good intentions. However, her status as the eldest daughter of the Qin family was very embarrassing. Due to the Qin family's reputation, she could not go to Suzhou to meet her biological mother.
Fortunately, with the development of the Internet, her younger sister Qin Ziling has gained more freedom at Yenching University. Li Ziqian, a good friend from Yenching University who is studying at Beijing University, contacted Jiang Fan. The family of three also just added the Penguin account. They met, got to know each other, and fell in love on the Internet social platform. It can be regarded as a harmonious reunion of the family of three on the Internet.
Brother, how are you doing? Is there any serious health problem? I want to go to Jinling to find you. Seeing the frightened words of my sister, who was afraid of losing her last relative, a warm current flowed through Jiang Fan's heart, and a feeling of guilt was unavoidable in his heart. Jiang Fan on the earth is no longer here, but Jiang Fan in Cangxuan Continent is here, and he will treat you as his own sister, and I will ensure that you have a worry-free life!
Jiang Fan was typing on the keyboard unfamiliarly, reassuring his sister not to believe Li Ziqian's lies. It was not as scary as the rumors. American Sullivan had been struck by lightning seven times, and he was safe every time. He survived without any sequelae.
In order to find a suitable excuse for cheating in the future, Jiang Fan once again boasted that those who can't be killed by lightning are the chosen ones. After being struck by lightning, his IQ soared from the original 120, and his body also opened up the Rendu and Du's two meridians. He punched the Bull Demon King, kicked Sun Wukong, tasted delicious, and had a great body!
Is it really okay? Looking at the message replied by his sister Qin Ziling, Jiang Fan felt embarrassed for a moment. He actually forgot that Penguin launched the mobile chat Penguin software for the Symbian system at the beginning of the year. The traffic is really beyond the reach of ordinary people. The traffic of one picture is equivalent to a lunch.
During the adaptation period to a new identity, chatting for too long can easily reveal your identity. Jiang Fan hurriedly ended the chat and turned off the computer on the pretext that he had to go to class. There was no other way. The only person who was most familiar with his predecessor was his sister Qin Ziling. An inappropriate remark might make the other person have wild thoughts.
There was almost no sound in the boys' dormitory. It may be because the flu was raging in the past few months. Major universities implemented strict epidemic control measures. They finally relaxed the blockade a little at the beginning of the month. Yesterday was Sunday again. The students in the dormitory building went to the Internet cafe to play games all night.
"Brother Lei, no, Lord Lei"
, Damn it, Jiang Fan staggered for a while. When he arrived at the teaching building of the School of Traditional Chinese Medicine, the counselor Lao Wang and many classmates who had returned from the whole night surrounded Jiang Fan and gasped, as if they were looking at aliens. They were struck by lightning and were not hurt at all.
Before Jiang Fan could say anything, a girl came angrily to the teaching building of the School of Traditional Chinese Medicine. The surrounding students quickly gave up the space as if they were watching a show. Jiang Fan looked at the girl who was walking towards him with a confused look on his face, as if he seemed a little familiar to her.
A wave of memories pressed into his mind came back again, and Jiang Fan secretly complained silently. His predecessor, Jiang Fan, had a girlfriend in the School of Life Sciences. Fortunately, the relationship only developed to the second base, and no substantial relationship happened. He couldn't help but secretly feel happy.
"Jiang Fan, let's break up. I'm worried about being struck by lightning when I'm with you!"
